title: Apply - ShaderParticleGeometry
content:
Member of: ShaderParticleGeometry Script Applies this effect, with an optional fade-in time. Syntax: Function Apply(float afFadeInTime = 0.0) native Parameters: - afFadeInTime: The time to fade over, in seconds Default: 0.0 Return Value: None. Examples: ; Apply the fire effect instantly FireEffect.Apply()
; Apply the freeze effect over 3 and a half seconds FreezeEffect.Apply(3.5) See Also: - ShaderParticleGeometry Script - Remove - ShaderParticleGeometry
